WG Third-party ready: cycle 2026-11-15 11:30 to 2026-11-16 11:30 UTC
Paused: 2 reports unacknowledged. Receive in a session or react 👍 to resume. (The 2026-11-14 and 2026-11-15 reports carry no 👍.)

1. Decisions for you: nothing new, but one fix. Four of the six below (21b6b4b7, 864eaebf, bc6bc746, c7a8e0a2) were still `draft` in the lifecycle, so no session or agenda showed them, though earlier reports called them proposed. I proposed them this cycle (record transition, propose); they are now on the agenda. Six proposed decisions wait on you (Action / Urgency as in the 2026-11-15 report):
- Structured findings for `record validate` and `container validate` (6882f577, srs-rust#1339 remainder). Recommendation: diagnosticsStructured beside errors. Decide. Low.
- May the group merge a Door 3 revision that only executes a ratified ruling? (de6b88c5, SP-02). Recommendation: a 30-day trial. Decide. Low.
- Field identity rules (21b6b4b7, srs#236, 17 days): srs#1016 landed, so it may be overtaken. Rule on it or close it. Decide. Medium.
- Heading-outline continuity (864eaebf, srs#991, 17 days): one rule, after a downstream audit. Decide. Medium.
- Is editor UI in the mandate (bc6bc746, srs-web#691, 12 days): route it to WG Agent-supported editor. Decide. Low.
- `note delete` default (c7a8e0a2, srs-rust#1497, 19 days): refuse notes with inbound Relations unless `--cascade`. Approve. Low.
Also waiting for your merge (approve): srs#1033 to #1037, all `gate:owner-merge`, each citing a ruling; untouched since 14 Nov.

2. Decided within mandate: none; no group session held and no decision was ready to ratify (no merged PR this cycle). Owner rulings this cycle: none new read.

3. Done: no group PRs merged this cycle (the last, srs-rust#1664, merged 2026-11-14 23:56). No quorum lines to report.

4. Stuck or lost: open group PRs (8): srs#1021 (`gate:auto-merge`, state `unstable`, 4 days, no merge); srs#1033 to #1037 (Door 3, your merge); srs-rust#1646 (rejected, behind master, no change in 5 days); srs-web#782 (rejected, merge conflict, no change in 6 days). Stops (needs-input): as before; not re-read. Owner-ruled escalations missing from either log: not re-checked.

5. Budget: 0 of 10 delegated merges this cycle; 8 open. Pause state: paused: 2 reports unacknowledged.
5b. Awaiting ratification: the six proposed decisions in section 1 are the only ones pending, the oldest 21b6b4b7 and 864eaebf at 17 days. Session to ratify: `clerk session --as owner --repo <srs-programme> --ratify all` (the-greenman/clerk; the TUI is `clerk --as owner`).

6. Next: ready issue counts not re-read this cycle (the last count was 12 ready, some blocked). Local priorities: none. Queue: the builder is paused, and its remaining ready work waits on the section 1 rulings. Waits on the owner: six decisions, five Door 3 merges, and the acknowledgement that resumes the group. Fed by the analyst: not re-read (last: 2026-11-11).

6b. Exercises: not re-read this cycle; the open ones in the last report stand.

7. What we learned: a decision created as a draft is invisible even when its status field reads proposed; four escalations sat unseen for up to 19 days (clerk check flags it, and my earlier cycles missed the lifecycle). Separately, the pause rule fired as designed. Two reports went unacknowledged and the group stopped merging, while the owner-side backlog (six decisions, five merges) did not move. That is the pattern the pause exists to expose. Build trigger (about 10 ratified decisions, then srs-web#560): not counted, not flagged. Measurement I1: 0 of 0 PRs in the window (it opens at the 11:30 cycleStart, so it is empty again); result dfeeb621-a9a5-44cc-9d90-bbf543b4fcc0. Whether it is useful, noisy or misleading is yours to give in a session. I2 to I4: pending.
